title: Philips Micro X-Clean Water Filter Cartridge 12pc $61.89 Delivered @ Amazon DE via AU
body:
Deal: Philips Micro X-Clean Water Filter Cartridge 12pc $61.89 Delivered @ Amazon DE via AU

[Ryder08] Anyone tried this and can comment on how they compare to Brita filters?
[Transient] We've been using Brita normal filters for 10+ years. Last best price was when Bunnings was selling them for about $6 each. Then Brita filter prices went up and stayed high, so we changed to these Philips filters. Find them the same but cheaper. Occasionally the water seems to stop filtering, so I just remove the filter, shake from side to side and pop it back in and it works fine again.
[conant] Oh, it does not sound very right to shake from side to side when the water stopped filtering… It stopped because the filter is blocked by something in the water…
[Transient] No, the instructions for both filters say to agitate it in water. The carbon granules in the filter sometimes become compacted so it becomes more difficult for the water to filter through under gravity. Shaking from side to side (horizontally) not vertically separates the granules so water can pass through more easily.
[bargaino] Proprietary water filters are wasteful and expensive.
For the price of 2 of these kits you can get a proper under-sink filter, with standard cartridges that last for a year or three. A little effort to install, but worth it.
[bargaino] https://www.google.com/search?q=2+stage+under+sink+water+fil…
Its generic. Bunnings or online.
